commitResults.messageBody:
Chatbot now echoes commands typed in by user and exits when user types in
"bye" or "Bye".

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement read/write for tasks in chatbot
commitResults.messageBody:
Added read/write functionality for tasks, users are able to see all tasks with "list" command;
adding a new task will add it to the list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Added functionalities to mark tasks as complete/incomplete
commitResults.messageBody:
Refactored code to add in Task class to better align with OOP
and encapsulation/abstraction principles.

* Private fields in Task to ensure abstraction barrier, status can only
be modified through setters and read through getters.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for tracking different types of tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Override toString method to create different String representations, all 3 subtypes of tasks inherit from Task class

commitResults.messageTitle: Update chatbot to handle invalid user input

commitResults.messageBody: Refactored code to use ArrayList instead of fixed size array
